strings.opt_set_106: The backup contains plaintext API keys, so only send it to yourself. Tick “encrypted export” to protect it with a passphrase (AES-GCM). The passphrase is not recoverable, so a lost file stays locked.
strings.opt_set_109: Automatically clears any variable whose name contains “key” so the recipient can put in their own. Keys typed directly inside a request template are not detected, so check before sharing.

strings.opt_lang_samehint: The panel's top bar has the same dropdown and the same value, so you can switch language on the fly without coming back here.
strings.opt_tpl_ph: Paste a curl here, or write a raw HTTP message
strings.opt_tpl_hint_text: curl or a raw HTTP message both work. Everything is sent verbatim except the placeholders. JSON cannot contain a bare newline (write \n); escape double quotes as \"; a leading # is a comment.
strings.opt_tpl_hint_ocr: Sent verbatim except the placeholders; the prompt goes directly in the request text, it is not a placeholder. See the chip tooltips above for the three image placeholders. Form-style endpoints like Baidu need {{imageUrlEncoded}} (a + inside base64 must become %2B, otherwise it turns into a space). Use {{apiKey}} for the key instead of hard-coding it.
strings.opt_imgtpl_title: Image request template (optional, click to fill)
strings.opt_imgtpl_ph: Leave empty to reuse the template above for images too
strings.opt_imgtpl_hint:
Once this is filled in (on the main request or any fallback), the config shows up in the OCR tab's image config list. It handles images; the template above keeps handling text. Leave it empty to fall back to the one above.
Write it the multimodal way, for example: {"role":"user","content":[{"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"{{image}}"}},{"type":"text","text":"Translate the text in the image into {{target}}, output only the translation"}]}
Inside this template {{text}} is the empty string: with direct image passing the image itself is the source.
strings.opt_path_hint_text: Dots plus indexes, e.g. data.translations[0].translatedText. When empty, common response shapes are tried in turn.
strings.opt_path_hint_ocr: Dots plus indexes, e.g. Baidu's words_result (one object per line, joined into one paragraph). When empty, common response shapes are tried in turn.
